headline: AI and data systems engineer
valueStatement: I build governed AI systems and data pipelines that make decisions traceable, testable and accountable to people.
availability: Open to remote, contract and globally distributed opportunities
summary: I work at the intersection of data engineering, governed AI and statistically validated decision systems. At MetaPOS, I build retail data workflows and MetaPOS Mind, a permission-aware context system for people and AI assistants.

My independent work includes OmniMind, a local AI-work control plane, and FXPM, a regime-aware trading research and execution system. I separate implemented controls from measured results, and keep human approval explicit where decisions carry risk.

I am studying Engineering Management at the University of Debrecen. My background combines data science training with practical data engineering and technical learning support across distributed teams.
identityNote: Bongo Seakhoa is also known professionally and legally in some records as Bongo Kosa. Both names refer to the same person and body of work.
